residual_risks: Resident selected-task departure is observed at the resident hourly scheduler boundary. This is scheduling resolution rather than a clock-derived destination, but finer reconsideration/departure cadence may become gameplay-relevant later.

causal_logic.summary: Current production movement is caused by explicit selected task, destination, actor route knowledge, feasible unique route, on-foot applicability, duration plan, departure and persisted progress; clock hour or profession no longer creates new travel or work.
evidence: SettlementSimulation.ExternalActorTravel requires a selected task, required destination, non-empty known route set, one unique known/open OnFoot path and Applicable traversal facts before BeginTravel.
SettlementSimulation.Routes declines to choose when multiple feasible known paths exist, avoiding an unmodeled route-choice law.
SettlementSimulation.HourPlan and P3ResidentScheduleLocationTests show clock hour/profession do not create current travel or work without a selected task.
P3DefaultTravelVerticalSliceTests exercises explicit task/authority through 300 m route, 214286 ms duration, departure, partial progress, save/load and exact arrival.
P3RouteInterruptionTests preserves and freezes the same travel plan when its active route becomes blocked, then resumes after reopening without teleportation.

historical_grounding.summary: The implementation stays within the accepted rural-English structural travel model and narrow continuous ordinary on-foot calibration; it does not promote one universal medieval commute, route graph or walking rule.
evidence: The accepted P3 semantic-location/travel audit grounds explicit routes, variable travel conditions, legal passage state, non-omniscient route knowledge and opportunity-caused movement while rejecting fixed clock commutes.

The accepted continuous-on-foot v1 scope limits 1400 mm/s timing to baseline-compatible short, ordinary, uninterrupted walking and leaves unknown/non-baseline/process-bearing journeys unresolved or inapplicable.
Production requires route timing class, actor capability, carried-load class and traversal horizon; Passable/Open alone is insufficient.
Default content creates no resident selected task, route knowledge, baseline actor capability or no-material-load authority.
